name: unit_converter
description: A unit converter that stores linear and affine conversions as a graph, chains them by breadth-first search and caches composed conversions.
bugs: Conversion.inverse() negates the offset without dividing it by the scale
Conversion.then() composes in the wrong order (applies other first), which only matters when offsets are involved
conversion() caches the reverse direction with the forward conversion instead of its inverse
